data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Efah means 'opener'. It is derived from the root 'afa' which means 'to open, to begin'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to open new opportunities and begin new journeys in life. The name Efah carries the meaning “Opener, Opener of the way” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Efah usually hope their child will grow to embody opener, opener of the way and live with faith, good character and purpose.
